Meridian Fulfillment - network roster.

Every fulfillment center keeps a roster.csv listing on-call pager
extensions by role. sites/roseburg/ is the active fulfillment center;
the Ardmore building closed in March 2026 and its roster is kept
under sites/ardmore/ for payroll history only.
